idea.title: Driver profile page
idea.description: A page per driver at /drivers/:id with their name, team, points, wins and a race-by-race results table. Link each driver name in the driver standings to it.
idea.planDetails:
Three PRs. t1 adds pure profile logic in src/lib, with `teamOf` moved out of DriverStandingsPage. t2 adds the /drivers/:id page with its route, story and tests. t3 links driver names in the standings to it. Each leaves the app working. Points and wins reuse `driverStandings`, so the profile always matches the standings table. Sprint results are not shown in the race table, because the idea asked only for race-by-race results. Sprint points are still counted in the total, as in the standings.

- driver-profile-logic-in-lib: Driver profile logic in lib
- driver-profile-page-and-route: Driver profile page and route
- link-standings-to-driver-profiles: Link standings to driver profiles

t1.title: Driver profile logic in lib
t1.description: Add a pure function that builds a driver's profile (team, points, wins, per-race results) from races, and share `teamOf` instead of keeping it private to the standings page.
t1.planDetails:
Responsibility: Add a pure function that builds a driver's profile (team, points, wins, per-race results) from races, and share `teamOf` instead of keeping it private to the standings page.

Files:
- src/lib/driverProfile.ts
- src/lib/driverProfile.test.ts
- src/pages/DriverStandingsPage.tsx

Acceptance:
- driverProfile(races, driverId) returns { team, points, wins, results[] }, with results as { round, raceName, grid, position, status, points } ordered by round
- points and wins equal the driver's row from driverStandings
- team is the constructor of the driver's last classified race
- returns undefined for an unknown driver id or a driver with no results
- DriverStandingsPage imports the shared team helper and renders exactly as before
- npm run gate reports 0 new failures

Test: src/lib/driverProfile.test.ts: with fixture races, checks the points/wins totals against driverStandings, the round ordering, the team from the last race, a mid-season team change, and undefined for an unknown driver.

t2.title: Driver profile page and route
t2.description: Add the /drivers/:id page showing name, team, points, wins and a race-by-race results table, with a not-found state.
t2.planDetails:
Responsibility: Add the /drivers/:id page showing name, team, points, wins and a race-by-race results table, with a not-found state.

- src/pages/DriverProfilePage.test.tsx
- src/pages/DriverProfilePage.stories.tsx
- src/App.tsx
- e2e/driver-profile.spec.ts

Acceptance:
- /drivers/:id shows the driver's full name, team (TeamSwatch), points, wins and a table with one row per race (race name, grid, finish, status, points)

- route registered in src/App.tsx
- no top-level nav link is added (this is a detail page)
- npm run gate reports 0 new failures

Test: src/pages/DriverProfilePage.test.tsx (renderAt('/drivers/<id>')): asserts name, team, points, wins, table row count and the not-found state. e2e/driver-profile.spec.ts: opens /drivers/<id> directly and checks the heading and the results table. Story with the withRouter decorator.
